newsitem.title: UK: United News after recent underperformance.
newsitem.headline: United News after recent underperformance.

text.p: Shares in United News and Media Plc advanced as investors searched out stocks that have underperformed the broad market during the last few weeks, market makers said.
By 1524 GMT, the shares were up 11p to 700-1/2, having risen to a four-month high at 703 earlier.
The benchmark FTSE 100, meanwhile, was up 14.5 points at 4,210.0, after climbing to a record peak at 4,227.5.
"The media sector was left behind the rest of the stock market in the last few weeks and investors are looking for value," said one.
